patterns: {amount} spent on your SBI Credit Card ending {acct} at {merchant} on {date}\.
rules.sample: Rs.240.00 spent on your SBI Credit Card ending 2383 at FASHNEARTECHNOLOGIESPRI on 23/10/26. Trxn. not done by you? Report at https://sbicard.com/Dispute

patterns: received payment of {amount} via (?<merchant>\w+) & the same has been credited to your SBI Credit Card(?: ending {acct})?\. Your available limit is {limit}
rules.sample: We have received payment of Rs.1,628.12 via BBPS & the same has been credited to your SBI Credit Card. Your available limit is Rs.196,000.00.

patterns: your payment of {amount} at {merchant} is due on {date:due} and will be processed through your credit card ending {acct}
rules.sample: Dear Cardholder, your payment of INR 906.30 at Amazon is due on 29/08/2026 and will be processed through your credit card ending 2383 as per e-Mandate (SiHub ID: XXXXXXXX) registered by you.

patterns: request to increase the Credit Limit
